description: This file contains Kotlin code implementing a Jetpack Compose UI for an Android app's post-onboarding tab interface. It defines composable functions for a tabbed interface with different sections including Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings, along with status bar and bottom navigation bar components.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: An enum class representing the different tabs in the UI (Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, Settings).

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: An enum class representing the different visual statuses of the connection (Connected, Connecting, Warning, Error, Offline).

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Composable function implementing the main tab UI with status bar, bottom navigation, and content handling for each tab, managing state such as active tab and connection status.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Composable that displays the screen tab content and handles refresh logic upon connection.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Composable rendering the top status bar with connection status indicator and label.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Composable rendering the bottom navigation bar with tab icons and labels.
